x: After him came the rest of the field close together, providing an excellent race. The Mile went to a newcomer, F. Walker, with the Penny brothers second and third.
In the 1 Mile Handicap we had F.
Barrett won the 220 yards, F. Walker was second in the 880 yards and F.
Martin and F. Walker, second and third, and a 2 Miles Walk, which was won by the limit-man, S.
Green had a little in hand, however, and went away from Jack down the straight. F. Walker once again secured third place and he strikes one as being distinctly promising.
Then came Dewberry and a man who has been placed in handicaps every time except once this season. I refer to F. Walker, who is probably a potential Club champion.
Mitchell, showing his old form, dropped into third place, with those three promising juniors, C. Penny, F.
Penny ran a very good race to finish 2nd, and the same applies to F. Walker (3rd) who recorded fourth fastest time.
